title: SSH Deploy Failed — Stale Hetzner IP
task: Deploy swing scanner + audit fixes to Hetzner VPS
what_happened: Committed 10aee83 with 670 insertions (6 files) and pushed to GitHub successfully
SSH to 5.78.76.228 (old IP from previous sessions) timed out on port 22
User provided Hetzner Console screenshots showing correct IP: 5.161.126.32
Retried with correct IP — git pull + docker rebuild succeeded in ~12 seconds
Docker service name mismatch: used 'shamrock-bot' (container name) instead of 'bot' (compose service name)
what_went_well: Git commit and push worked flawlessly
Docker build used layer caching — rebuild was fast (~2s)
Code changes were syntactically valid (all AST parse checks passed)
Recovered quickly once correct IP was identified
what_went_wrong: Used hardcoded stale IP (5.78.76.228) from a previous session instead of checking
No sync-and-deploy workflow file existed — was listed in workflows but missing
Used container name 'shamrock-bot' as docker compose service name — should be 'bot'
root_cause: IP address was hardcoded from memory of previous conversations rather than stored in a canonical location (workflow file). The sync-and-deploy workflow was referenced but never actually created.
resolution: Documented correct Docker service names: bot, dashboard, health, db
Added note to check Hetzner Console if IP changes
